cumulus/grell-freitas.label: Grell-Freitas
warnings: Grell-Freitas's distance from WRF v4.6.1 is MEASURED on both halves of the port and on the whole driver, not a scheme fragment. tools/gf_wrf461_oracle drives the byte-frozen module_cu_gf_wrfdrv.F/module_cu_gf_deep.F/module_cu_gf_sh.F at gfortran -O0 over 18 cases x 6 grid spacings x 2 ishallow arms (216 columns); the float32 CPU authority (gpuwm/verify/gf_driver.py) reproduces GFDRV word for word on the 208 columns where GFDRV's own decomposition is exact, and the CUDA translation unit (gpuwm/core/kernels/gf.cu) holds the same boundary with the fzu normalisation PINNED from the capture, exactly as the CPU suite pins it: its transcribed glibc-2.39 logf/expf/powf are bitwise against the live-glibc sweeps, and gamma is graded instead against a 113-bit oracle because it is a deliberate divergence since 2.6.6 -- see the next warning (tests/test_gf_deep_cuda.py, tests/test_gf_shallow_cuda.py, tests/test_gf_gfdrv_cuda.py, tests/test_gf_gamma_correctly_rounded.py). The 8 remaining columns are the driver's own module_gfs_physcons mixed precision, inherited and bounded (max 34 ULP, 3.8e-6 relative, no branch flips). That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation: no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, which is why it is 'implemented-unverified' and not 'supported'.

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, an ArWen design ruling (no inherited WRF bugs) -- GAMMA. Read ArWen's documentation before quoting any GF parity number. gfortran binds WRF's F2008 gamma() to glibc's tgammaf, which is NOT correctly rounded: MEASURED against a 113-bit oracle over all 59,768,833 float32 of [0.25, 36], it is wrong on 23,575,230 (39.4440 per cent), worst 6 ULP; tgammaf(4.0f) returns 6.00000048, not 6. Through 2.6.5 ArWen's earlier gamma returned those same words; it is replaced, and like its replacement it was this project's own work under the project's licence. gfk_tgamma is now ArWen's own correctly rounded gamma (0 of 59,768,833 arguments wrong) and the SHIPPED forecast path computes it, so fzu is no longer WRF's word: it changes on 68.1707 per cent of the reachable set, 98.390 per cent of that within 4 ULP, worst 12. MEASURED forecast consequence on the committed 216-column WRF v4.6.1 capture: the deep mass flux xmb moves by up to ~7 per cent, median 1.9 (tests/test_gf_deep_parity.py::test_a_one_ulp_massflux_shape_perturbation_moves_xmb_by_seven_percent). ArWen is the closer of the two to the value the scheme's equations define on 49.95 per cent of the reachable set and further on 9.59; NEITHER is determined to better than tens of per cent, so this is NOT a skill claim. To compare against WRF column by column, pin fzu through the fzu_override slots the three stage kernels expose (INS_fzu_up/dn, SINS_fzu_sh, DINS_fzu_up/dn/sh) -- a runtime input, not a build flag.

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, an ArWen design ruling (no inherited WRF bugs): WRF's shallow k22 trigger is a MAXLOC over the array section heo_cup(2:kbmax) whose result module_cu_gf_sh.F uses as an absolute level index without adding the section offset, leaving k22 one level below the argmax wherever the argmax sits above level 2. The SHIPPED kernel uses the corrected indexing; the WRF-faithful off-by-one lives behind a launch flag only the parity suites set. Measured over the committed fixture: k22 moves on 3 of 18 cases (6, 13, 16), all three rejected under both modes with identical ierr, and ZERO output words differ at the scheme or driver boundary (tests/test_gf_shallow_cuda.py, the ledger test).

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, WRF is undefined: get_inversion_layers' first-derivative loop reads t_cup(kend+8) past the array end whenever kend > ktf-8 (module_cu_gf_deep.F, both live call sites pass kend = kstabi). The port clamps kend to ktf-8 -- the oracle capture clamps identically -- and COUNTS the clamps; the count is zero on the whole committed fixture and the gates assert it stays zero.

ENGINE SEAM, recorded deviations of the cu_physics=3 adapter (gpuwm/core/gf.py) -- the kernel behind it is bitwise; this is what the engine can hand it today, and it is the plumb-list for any label upgrade: (1) GFDRV's boundary-layer forcing (RTHBLTEN/RQVBLTEN) is fed the PBL slot's own raw dry-theta/qv rates, whichever of YSU, MYJ, MYNN, Shin-Hong or SASE holds the slot, and its radiative forcing (RTHRATEN) is fed the driver's held rates; the ADVECTIVE half (RTHFTEN/RQVFTEN) is fed the integrator's own exported rates -- the ARW dycore captures pure theta and qv advection at RK stage 1 of every step, uncoupled to K s-1 and kg kg-1 s-1 with a one-step lag, and the MPAS seam's caller supplies its own -- so all four forcing lanes are live.  PURE advection by construction: WRF's module_cumulus_driver.F:867 pre-folds RTHRATEN+RTHBLTEN into RTHFTEN for G3/NTiedtke and NOT for GFSCHEME, which sums the lanes itself; (2) GF's convective momentum tendencies are computed but not yet coupled (CumulusResult carries no momentum slots); (3) mass-level w is the KF-precedent average of the staggered field.

MEASURED regime behaviour (2026-08-17, 12 km single-domain real-case twins on the tree route, 150x120x49, 6 h, KF control differing only in cu_physics/cudt): under strong synoptic forcing (1974-04-03 12-18Z) GF's domain-mean RAINC is ~40% of the KF control's -- ordinary inter-scheme spread; under weak forcing (1999-05-03 12-18Z, Ohio valley) it is 1-2% of KF's, i.e. the scheme is nearly silent where KF still rains. A column-level kernel probe of the weak-forcing state (18,000 real columns through gf_gfdrv_stage) found the deep trigger rejecting every column under four forcing arms alike -- the then-shipped zero-forcing seam, HFX/QFX-reconstructed RTHBLTEN/RQVBLTEN, and radiative forcing of either sign -- so the weak-forcing silence is the bitwise scheme's own trigger/closure response to these inputs, not a numeric defect at the adapter seam. A user expecting KF-like convective rain from cu_physics=3 on a weakly forced case will see almost none; that is the measured shape of the scheme as fed then, recorded here so it is not re-diagnosed as breakage. NOTE (2026-08-20): those twins predate the boundary-layer forcing lanes. Re-measured on a 12 km GEM real case, one forecast hour, GF+YSU, feeding RTHBLTEN/RQVBLTEN moves domain-total RAINC by 12.8% (3.3% at 3 km, where the scale-aware closure damps itself), so the KF-relative ratios above are indicative and not re-verified against the current seam.

cumulus/new-tiedtke.label: New Tiedtke
warnings: New Tiedtke's distance from WRF v4.6.1 is MEASURED at the STAGE level and at the ASSEMBLED-PIPELINE level, not on a scheme fragment. tools/ntiedtke_wrf461_oracle drives the byte-frozen module_cu_ntiedtke.F/cu_ntiedtke.F90 at gfortran -O0 over 18 cases x 6 grid spacings (108 columns); cu_ntiedtke_pre_run and cu_ntiedtke_post_run are reached through objcopy --globalize-symbol and graded DIRECTLY, field by field, at zero differing words. All 21 CUDA stages reproduce their captured boundaries bitwise, and the assembled pipeline reproduces nt-levels.csv bitwise from the driver inputs alone, graded at EVERY capture boundary rather than end to end. That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation: no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, which is why it is 'implemented-unverified' and not 'supported'.

ENGINE SEAM, recorded deviations of the cu_physics=16 adapter (gpuwm/core/ntiedtke.py NewTiedtke): (1) THE FOLD IS DONE HERE. WRF's module_cumulus_driver.F:879-880 pre-folds RTHFTEN = (RTHFTEN + RTHRATEN + RTHBLTEN) * pi and RQVFTEN = RQVFTEN + RQVBLTEN for G3SCHEME and NTIEDTKESCHEME only. Note the * pi: the theta lane is multiplied by the Exner function, so the scheme receives a TEMPERATURE forcing. GF is NOT in that list and sums the lanes itself, so ArWen's dycore export stays PURE ADVECTION and must not move -- doing the fold in the adapter is what keeps it that way. (2) The domain is walked in chunks capped at Grell-Freitas's tile (SMs x 4 x 64 columns); the chunking is proven invisible at caps of 32, 64 and 108 on the fixture, valid there because every column entering cuascn with ldcum true carries klab(klev) > 0 so llo3 is invariant under re-chunking. (3) stepcu is pinned to 1 and cudt_minutes to 0: the scheme's RAINCV is rn/stepcu, a per-call rate with no persistence, so a hold would reapply it every step. (4) The scheme's momentum tendencies ARE coupled -- CumulusResult carries rucuten/rvcuten and they go through the same A-grid-to-C-grid face path YSU's momentum takes.

COVERAGE GAPS, named rather than left implicit: the fixture drives stepcu = 1, where all three of the scheme's stepcu expressions are identities, so the handling of a cumulus step longer than the model step is transcribed and ungraded. cu_ntiedtke_run's :278-320 post-conversion and cumastrn's body are transcribed rather than called -- they are inside routines rather than being routines, so no objcopy reaches them -- and rest on run_nt_cumastrn.F90's single convergence proof against the real cu_ntiedtke_run. The deep-to-shallow demotion at cu_ntiedtke.F90:566 (cumastrn, WRF v4.6.1 phys/physics_mmm) is not exercised by any fixture case.

New Tiedtke runs with the PBL slot off. It reads no KPBL, its surface fluxes come from the surface layer and the land-surface model rather than from the PBL scheme, and its advective-forcing lanes are the zero planes WRF's own cumulus driver folds in when no PBL tendency exists. The measured runs all carry a PBL scheme, so the PBL-off configuration is admitted on the field contract, not on evidence.

land_surface/noah.label: Four-layer Noah LSM
warnings: NOAH IS NOW MEASURED AGAINST WRF AND IT IS NOT BITWISE. tools/noah_wrf461_oracle/build.sh drives the byte-unmodified phys/module_sf_noahdrv.F subroutine lsm -- the exact scope kernels/noah.cu transcribes, prep and post-update included -- over 42 land columns, and tests/test_noah_wrf461_parity.py pins the result. ESTABLISHED: seven of the 31 driver outputs are bit-identical to WRF on every column of all four switch fixtures (albbck, emiss, z0, snotime, acsnow, chklowq and the whole TSLB soil-temperature profile); TSK is within 2 ULP, LH/QSFC/ALBEDO 3, QFX/POTEVP 5, SNOWC/CANWAT 8, SNOWH 9, SNOW 10, GRDFLX 170, HFX 375. NOT ESTABLISHED: no gpuwm/WRF forecast-trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, which is what validation-candidate would require, and four divergence populations below are open.

OPEN 1, FROZEN-GROUND INFILTRATION. On the three fixture columns that are simultaneously frozen and melting snow, SFCRUNOFF is 6.06e7 ULP from WRF (8.5e-05 mm against 4.9e-03 mm over a 60 s step) and SH2O is 6508 ULP. SRT (module_sf_noahlsm.F:3792-3806) scales the infiltration limit by FCR, an expf of a powf series in CVFRZ*FRZX/DICE, then forms RUNOFF1 = PCPDRP - INFMAX between two nearly equal quantities. The transcription is faithful line for line; what differs is CUDA's expf/powf against glibc's, amplified by that split. The water is redistributed, not lost: the 4.85e-03 mm runoff gap is the same water as the 4.85e-05 volumetric SH2O gap. Closing it needs the gpuwm/core/noahmp_libm.py treatment applied to the device transcendentals Noah reaches.

OPEN 2, A SUBNORMAL SNOW DEPTH TAKES THE WRONG BRANCH. CuPy appends -ftz=true unconditionally, so where WRF's IF(SNOW(I,J).GT.0.0) is true for the smallest positive float32 subnormal and the column takes the ice-saturation Q2SAT/DQSDT2 blend, the kernel's snow > 0.0f is false and it takes the snow-free arm: 0.083 K in TSK, 1.95 W/m2 in HFX, 2.87 W/m2 in LH. Fixture case 18. This is a branch disagreement on an unphysical input, not an error in the physics, but it is the fourth instance of the -ftz class in this project.

OPEN 3, THE ENERGY RESIDUAL IS A DIFFERENT FUNCTION. NOAHRES is accumulated in float64 and rounded once by kernels/noah.cu where module_sf_noahdrv.F:1308 accumulates it in float32. The sum cancels terms of order 500 W/m2 into a residual of order 0.01, so WRF's value carries only its low bits and is quantised to ~3e-05. gpuwm's number is the more accurate one and it is not WRF's. NOAHRES is diagnostic and feeds no prognostic variable.

OPEN 4, SFLX_GLACIAL IS NOT PORTED, and the cost is now measured rather than merely named. On a land-ice column (ivgtyp == isice) noah_column returns without touching the state while WRF runs module_sf_noahlsm_glacial_only.F: after one 60 s step TSK is 255.0 against 273.15 K, HFX 0 against 388.9 W/m2, LH 0 against -319.1 W/m2, GRDFLX 0 against -42.2 W/m2 and SH2O 0.28 against 1.0. The bundle's d01 has no land-ice points (pinned in tests/test_noah.py); any domain that does must not use this scheme.

WHAT THE ORACLE FOUND ON ITS FIRST RUN, and what that says about the previous evidence: CHKLOWQ was 0 instead of 1 on open-water and sea-ice columns, because module_sf_noahdrv.F writes it for every column at :809-814 before the XLAND branch while noah_column returned from its three skip paths without writing it. CHKLOWQ multiplies the moisture flux at the surface-layer seam. Thirty-seven self-consistency tests could not see it: gpuwm.verify.npref.np_noah_column already had it right, so the CUDA-versus-mirror sweeps never compared the field on a skipped column. Fixed; that field is now bit-identical on every column.

The parameter tables carry their own separate evidence: gpuwm/data/noah_tables VEGPARM.TBL, SOILPARM.TBL and GENPARM.TBL are byte-identical to WRF v4.6.1's run/ directory (tests/test_noah.py::test_shipped_tables_byte_identical_to_wrf_run_dir), and the oracle harness reads them through WRF's own SOIL_VEG_GEN_PARM, so the fixture also checks gpuwm's transcription of that list-directed READ sequence rather than assuming it.

land_surface/noah-mp.label: Noah-MP land-surface model
warnings: Noah-MP RUNS and is UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. Every routine of the column is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_sf_noahmplsm.F and NOAHMP_SFLX is bitwise on all four whole-column fixtures, but no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, which is what validation-candidate would require. tests/test_noahmp_runtime.py is the standing runtime gate.

The whole column runs on the DEVICE: the slab orchestration (gpuwm/core/noahmp_column_slab.py) answers every land column with no Python per column, in chunks of SLAB_COLUMN_CHUNK (65,536), and is bitwise -- max ULP 0 -- against the scalar column authority on twelve heterogeneous fixture columns field by field, at a full 65,536-column chunk, and end to end at 360,000 columns. Measured 2026-07-27, twice, on one RTX 5090: a 360,000-land-column call costs 0.202-0.227 s through the slab path, i.e. 7.3-8.2 wall seconds per simulated minute at dt=1.667 s with bldt=0, against 4,982-5,977 through the retired per-column CPython solver this warning used to describe (97% interpreter time, 6.4 ms per land column, flat). Absolute seconds are a property of the machine; this box varies up to 30% between harnesses and hours. The staged per-column path remains the paired second implementation (GPUWM_NOAHMP_STAGED_COLUMNS=1) and GPUWM_NOAHMP_HOST_LEAVES=1 still selects the CPython leaves on it. The scaling blocker this warning used to record is RETIRED.

GLACIER columns run the dedicated NOAHMP_GLACIER port: a column whose VEGTYP equals ISICE_TABLE dispatches to the module_sf_noahmp_glacier.F transcription (gpuwm/core/noahmp_glacier.py host authority, gpuwm/core/kernels/noahmp_glacier.cu device, bitwise twins), never to NOAHMP_SFLX, which is not a substitute for it.

SEA-ICE columns (XICE >= xice_threshold) take WRF's own skip, so a Noah-MP run has no sea-ice surface energy balance: TSK/HFX/QFX over sea ice keep whatever the surface layer left. XICE_THRESHOLD defaults to WRF's Registry 0.5 and is configurable per run (NoahmpRuntimeParameters xice_threshold; initialize_physics and run_mpas_column_batch pass it through).

WRF's SIX-RATE precipitation seam is active. The surface driver carries convective, nonconvective, shallow-convective, snow, graupel and hail accumulations from their real writers, and noahmplsm takes module_sf_noahmpdrv.F:776-789's PRESENT(MP_*) branch including PRCPOTHR.

COSZEN is a radiation-driver carrier. Noah-MP consumes the last radiation call's value unchanged between calls, including radconst's half-radiation-interval hour-angle offset. A radiation-free run still binds start time and latitude/longitude and seeds the same offset value once.

26 of NOAHMP_SFLX's roughly 120 outputs are stored and written (gpuwm/core/noahmp_runtime.py NOAHMP_DIAGNOSTICS_2D). The rest are computed and discarded rather than zero-filled. WRF's module_diag_misc.F output accumulators have no gpuwm counterpart at all, so noahmp_output and noahmp_acc_dt change nothing.

Four WRF Registry restart carriers are MEASURED INERT over one step under this identity: a +5 K TAHXY, a 50%-larger CHXY or CMXY and a +0.3 FWETXY all leave the next step bit identical, because TAH/CH/CM are re-derived by converging iterations in VEGE_FLUX/SFCDIF1 and FWET is unconditionally reassigned by PRECIP_HEAT.

When the MYNN 5/5 pairing is selected, WRF v4.6.1 runs the MYNN surface layer first, then NOAHMP_SFLX overwrites TSK/HFX/QFX/LH on its active land columns while leaving UST/CHS/CHS2/CQS2/FLHC/FLQC with MYNN. The surface-driver post-pass unconditionally replaces MYNN's T2/Q2/TH2 with Noah-MP's water/urban/vegetated diagnostics before MYNN PBL consumes them. The source transcription and writer-order tests are in tools/mynn_surface_pairing_wrf461_oracle and tests/test_mynn_surface_pairing_ownership.py.

The pinned option identity is the exact WRF Registry default; opt_crop, opt_irr, opt_irrm, opt_infdv and opt_tdrn are admitted at 0 only, and num_soil_layers at 4 only. No other value of any Noah-MP knob has been measured -- not approximated, not measured.

land_surface/ruc-lsm.label: RUC land-surface model
warnings: RUC RUNS and is UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. Every routine of the column is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_sf_ruclsm.F and the assembled driver is bitwise against oracle/lsmruc.csv except its 26 pinned upstream-residue cells, but no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists, which is what validation-candidate would require. tests/test_ruc_runtime.py is the standing runtime gate; ArWen's documentation is the record.

THE COLUMN RUNS ON THE CARD, and the wall clock is measured at production width rather than extrapolated from a narrow grid. gpuwm/core/ruc_runtime.py ruc_lsm_step passes the CUDA leaf set, the CUDA snow-preparation stage and the CuPy array namespace into gpuwm/core/ruc.py ruc_land_surface_step, so LSMRUC's prologue, the sfctmp dispatch's masking and mosaic recombination, the four leaves and the epilogue are all device work and the surface slab never leaves the card. On an RTX 5090 at d04's 360,000 columns with dt=1.667 s and bldt=0: 16.8 wall seconds per simulated minute snow-free (0.47 s per land-surface call) and 65.7 fully snow-covered (1.83 s per call). That REPLACES the flat 1.687 to 1.724 ms per land column this row used to publish, which was the Python column loop and projected to 613 s -- ten minutes -- for one d04 call. The device path is max_ulp 0 against that host path over all 43 returned fields at 512, 4,096 and 24,576 columns, warm and snow, paired in one process; tests/test_ruc_device_column.py is the gate and it is two-sided. What is still host work is SFCDIAGS_RUCLSM, which raises (1e5/psfc) to R/cp and would change answer on CUDA's powf, so it is left where its arithmetic is verified.

WRF reads ilnb UNINITIALISED on a thin snow pack and gpuwm does not reproduce it. sfctmp declares ilnb at :1385 and never initialises it; snowseaice takes it intent(inout) and snowtemp intent(out), so it is undefined on entry by the Fortran standard, and both read it at if(ilnb.gt.1) (:4410, :5716) to select the one- or two-layer tsnav. microphysics/milbrandt2mom-mp9.label: Milbrandt-Yau two-moment / MP9
warnings: NO ORACLE HAS BEEN RUN. This option is a line-by-line transcription of the byte-frozen WRF v4.6.1 phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:841-3485 (mp_milbrandt2mom_main), :564-836 (sedi_wrapper_2/sedi_1D/count_columns), :31-433 and :3489-3525 (the helper functions) and :3559-3703 (the 3-D wrapper) -- and what has been TESTED is a column smoke driving the shipped seams (initialize_physics + microphysics.apply) for finiteness, boundedness and moment-vs-mass consistency, plus a water budget that closes to the reported precipitation on three seeding layouts. Read the budget narrowly: it detects a source/sink term only where that term is non-zero on the column, so it resolves the deposition, riming and melting families and NOT the terms that are zero on all three columns, and the number-only source/sink lines at phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:2721-2728 carry no mass and cannot appear in a water budget at all. The layouts and the measured per-term margins are in tests/test_milbrandt2.py. There is NO comparison against the WRF Fortran: no ULP table, no column oracle, no matched forecast trajectory. The oracle campaign is the declared next stage, as it was for Shin-Hong and Grell-Freitas before their measurements landed.

PINNED IDENTITY, not a subset. WRF exposes no namelist for any Milbrandt-Yau switch: mp_milbrandt2mom_driver hard-codes CCNtype=2 (continental, phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:3615), precipDiag/sedi/warmphase/autoconv/icephase/snow all .true. (:3618-3623) and nk_BOTTOM=.false. (:3591), and the scheme body hard-codes snowSpherical=.false. (:1174), primIceNucl=1 (:1175) and grpl/hail/rainAccr/iceDep ON (:1170-1173). mp=9 therefore has exactly ONE identity in WRF v4.6.1 and ArWen ships that one; gpuwm/config.py::validate_milbrandt2_options refuses by name any request to move one, because the 154-entry constant table in gpuwm/core/milbrandt2_constants.py is derived under these settings (CCNtype=2 fixes N_c_SM=2e8, snowSpherical=.false. selects the Brandes m(D) pair).

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, WRF is undefined or unreachable, four of them, each commented at its site in the ported translation unit gpuwm/core/kernels/milbrandt2.cu. (1) phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:2819-2823 is a LIVE print-and-STOP on T<173 K or T>323 K -- a device kernel cannot abort a run and ArWen's step-level health gate owns that decision, so the value is left as computed. (2) count_columns at phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:821 would read QX(i,0) when ktop_sedi==kbot, which needs the lowest two layers to span 20 km, so the walk is clamped to 'inactive'. (3) phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:1733, :1754 and :1771 each zero iLAMxB1 twice and never zero iLAMxB2 -- every iLAMxB2 read sits inside the Qx>epsQ branch that also writes it, so the stale value is unreachable and the defined behaviour (zeroing) is implemented. (4) RT_snd at phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:3224-3262 and RT_peL at :3321-3327 are computed by the scheme and DISCARDED by mp_milbrandt2mom_driver, so they are not computed at all.

TRANSCRIBED WRF QUIRKS, deliberately NOT corrected because they are defined behaviour: the surface precipitation diagnostic reads N_r, DE and T at the model TOP while reading QR at the bottom (phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:3298-3313, nk vs kbot); the raindrop-breakup efficiency tests iLAMr rather than Dr and goes negative for large iLAMr (:2951); the hail size-sorting ratio omits the air-density factor its Dm_x sibling carries (:698); and with T>0 C the pristine-ice mass is zeroed at :2042 and the resulting QMLir is then cancelled by the ice overdepletion guard, so that mass leaves the system rather than becoming rain. The scheme's own 4-term-truncated Lanczos gamma (:160-195, 'do j=1,4') is used throughout -- gamma(3) comes out 1.9999542 and that is the number every WRF mp=9 run integrates with.

DECLARED DIVERGENCE, RTE+RRTMGP cloud optics (ArWen's own; WRF has no RRTMGP and hands RRTMG no Milbrandt-Yau radii, has_reqc=has_reqi=has_reqs=0 at phys/module_physics_init.F:1004-1023). The adapter radiates the scheme's OWN effective radii: the block WRF ships commented out at phys/module_mp_milbrandt2mom.F:3351-3378 -- r_eff = M_D(3)/(2 M_D(2)) over MY2005a eqn (2), 0.664639/lambda_c for the alpha_c=1, mu_c=3 cloud distribution and 1.5/lambda_i for exponential ice, with the scheme's own iLAMDA_x constants and iLAMmin2 floor -- evaluated from the transported nc/ni on every radiation call, and extended to snow as 1.5/lambda_s over the alpha_s=0 exponential with the Brandes m(D) pair (cms=0.1597, dms=2.078) that snowSpherical=.false. selects. Ice and snow merge into RRTMGP's one ice species by number and clip to the table domain exactly as Morrison's row does. The legacy RRTMG arm is unchanged: it computes its own radii as WRF does under has_reqc=0, so the two arms radiate DIFFERENT cloud radii for mp=9 by design; the verification of record is obs skill, not agreement between them.

warnings: Measured against WRF's own Fortran, not against itself. The two long mixed-phase cases, F07 (40 steps) and F10 (90 steps), are exact for 3 and 2 steps and then bifurcate -- a property of the system and not of the port, because a one-ULP nudge to the FORTRAN'S OWN input diverges it from itself by 100 percent within ten steps, measured. The parsed lookup table is exact: substituting the Fortran's own generated tables changes nothing. Transport, restart and invariants are pinned separately at the shipped seams (tests/test_p3_port.py): qir/qib advect bitwise with the ice they describe, a checkpoint taken after real dycore steps restores bit-exactly, and qirim<=qitot with 50<=rho_rime<=900 hold through a 15-step integration closing total water to 1e-4 against surface precipitation, with a mutation control that fails when the solver is stubbed out. STILL OPEN: an unexplained 1-6 ULP residual in the ice fields after immersion freezing, localised to qib on F06/F08/F11 and CUDA-specific, and F09, whose disagreement is separate, broader and not localised (ArWen's evidence records). STILL TRUE: no matched WRF forecast run, no forecast-trajectory comparison, and no comparison against observations. Per-step numerical agreement with Fortran is not evidence of forecast skill, which is why the maturity rung stays implemented-unverified.

P3 has ONE ice category: an mp=50 run produces no QSNOW and no QGRAUP field at all, and no GRAUPELNC accumulator. Its single ice species carries a predicted rime mass fraction and rime density instead, which is what spans the snow/graupel/hail range other schemes split. Output and verification tooling that assumes the six-species inventory will not find those fields.

mp=50 runs on the card. p3_backend selects the implementation: 'cuda' (the default, nine kernel launches), 'fused' (the same kernels in three), and 'reference' (the CPU float32 transcription that is the port's own authority). The two device arms are byte-identical to each other on every p3-fortref fixture. The decomposition is one thread per column with k sequential inside the thread, so the authority's arithmetic ORDER is preserved by construction rather than by care, and the translation unit compiles with -fmad=false because contraction was measured to move the numbers. p3_backend is scoped to mp=50 in SCHEME_SCOPED_RUN_FIELDS and refused at a non-default value under any other scheme, so selecting an arm cannot move another experiment's restart fingerprint.

That campaign is the declared next stage, as it was for Shin-Hong and Grell-Freitas.

MYJ and the Eta similarity surface layer are selected TOGETHER or not at all. WRF v4.6.1's own law is one-directional -- phys/module_physics_init.F:3770-3772 fatals bl_pbl_physics=2 unless the surface layer set isfc=2, which only sf_sfclay_physics=2 does among the layers gpuwm ports (:3169) -- and ArWen adds the reverse refusal for a stated reason: the Eta layer publishes AKHS/AKMS/THZ0/QZ0/UZ0/VZ0 and publishes NO MOL, ZOL, PSIM/PSIH, REGIME, GZ1OZ0 or WSPD (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:361-1056), while YSU, MYNN, Shin-Hong and SASE each read at least one of those. Pairing them would hand a PBL scheme a zero where WRF hands it a similarity function: finite, plausible and wrong. gpuwm.config.validate_myj_pairing is that refusal.

WRF quirks transcribed rather than repaired, each cited in the port. CT (the countergradient correction) is identically zero in ARW: MYJSFC zeroes it every call (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:206-211) and SFCDIF's countergradient block is commented out (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:816-825, CT=0.), so MIXLEN's DTH+CT fix (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:845-850) and VDIFH's RKCT term add exactly zero -- both seams are still built so a future WRF that restores them lands in the right place. CZIL is hard-coded to 0.1 because the Chen-Zhang block is commented out (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:689-697), which is why IVGTYP/ISURBAN/IZ0TLND are dead arguments and why gpuwm.config refuses isftcflx/iz0tlnd with this surface layer. The Zilitinkevich thermal-roughness fix reads Z0BASE, not the working ZNT (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:733). DIFCOF's inversion block is commented out (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:1275-1322), so its T argument is dead and the port does not take it.

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, gpuwm goes its own way (float32 precision): the interface-height column is GROUND-relative. WRF seeds it with the terrain height, ZINT(I,KTE+1,J)=HT(I,J) (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:312, phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:162), so every height it carries is above sea level; gpuwm seeds zero. Every consumer in both modules reads only DIFFERENCES of those heights, so HT cancels EXACTLY in real arithmetic and only APPROXIMATELY in float32, where differencing numbers offset by 1-3 km drops bits the ground-relative column keeps. gpuwm's column is the more accurate one, which is why it ships. The cancellation is MEASURED rather than assumed: over five columns (four stretched so no dz and no interface height is an exactly representable float32) crossed with terrain at 1523.7, 2987.3 and 4411.1 m, land and water, KPBL is identical in every case, non-tendency fields move at most 69 ULP -- attained on lh over water, where the move is 1.645e-05 W m-2 -- and at most 5.75e-06 relative, attained on qfx rather than on lh, and tendency rows move at most 2.05 quanta of the source field's ULP over dt (tests/test_myj_port.py::test_the_dropped_terrain_height_cancels_in_float32). It will be a real term in the ULP table when the oracle campaign runs.

OUT OF SCOPE, refused rather than approximated. WRF sends the MYJ PBL through myjurb (phys/module_bl_myjurb.F:130-771) when sf_urban_physics is 2 or 3, the BEP/BEM multi-layer urban canopies (phys/module_physics_init.F:3775-3781). gpuwm does the same: PhysicsDriver._run_myj_pbl routes MYJ to gpuwm.core.myjurb under the bep and bep-bem urban options. With sf_surface_physics=0 the land branch stops evolving surface humidity rather than failing: MYJPBL rebuilds QSFC over land from ELFLX and CHKLOWQ, both of which an LSM writes, and its IF(QFC1>0.) guard leaves QSFC untouched when they are zero (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:547-557). That is WRF's own behaviour and it is admitted, not refused -- but a land run without an LSM is a land run whose surface moisture is frozen at its initial value. The MYJPBL species stack is WRF's own three or four rows (theta, vapour, cloud water and cloud ice when the moist set carries it): the QCS/QCR/QCG rows the source declares are commented out upstream (:274-285) and are not ported. The kernel holds the column in per-thread local memory like YSU's, so it carries the same 128-level ceiling and refuses a deeper column rather than truncating it.

pbl/sase.label: SASE PBL
warnings: EXPERIMENTAL, AND NOT A WRF SCHEME. SASE (Scale-Adaptive Stress-Energetics) is an ArWen-only turbulence closure with no WRF v4.6.1 counterpart, so no oracle comparison against WRF Fortran exists or can exist for it, and it carries no WRF selector number -- bl_pbl_physics=900 is outside WRF's namespace on purpose. Every other option in this registry is measured as a distance from WRF; this one cannot be. Read its maturity as 'the numerics are self-checked', never as 'the physics is validated'.

SCIENTIFICALLY UNVALIDATED, and its own acceptance scorecard says so. Scored against a single reference case on a single day, the closure met 2 of 7 frozen physical acceptance bars and missed 5, including a total absence of the low-cloud deck that its conditional-venting limb exists to act on (median liquid water path 0.0 g/m2 against a reference of 132-235). Nothing measured speaks to any other case. Do not use it for a forecast you intend to believe.

KNOWN OPEN BIAS in the subgrid energy magnitude: the one-constant closure's equilibrium subgrid TKE sits roughly 3-5x below the observed value (sqrt(e) about 2x low), which biases the stability lengths, the horizontal diffusivity, the buoyancy flux and every TKE product it writes. This is registered and unfixed, and it blocks scientific claims about TKE magnitudes.

RUNTIME RESTRICTIONS, refused at config load rather than warned: the closure replaces the km_opt mixing operator so it requires km_opt=0 and khdif=kvdif=0 (stacking would double-count); it requires a surface-layer scheme, because its lower boundary condition is that scheme's friction velocity and heat/moisture fluxes; it requires moist=true; its vertical momentum tendency is held across the configured PBL interval and checkpointed; and its implicit vertical solve carries its tridiagonal columns in per-thread local memory, which bounds it to nz <= 128.

HORIZONTAL OPERATORS WRAP PERIODICALLY. The test filters, strain and horizontal flux stencils wrap in x and y unconditionally. On a specified or nested domain the mitigation is that the subgrid energy is held at its floor across the outer spec_bdy_width rows every step and the same width is excluded from the closure's solve reductions -- an adjudicated boundary treatment, not a halo exchange.

MEASURED ON REAL DATA, AND IT DID NOT COMPLETE. The closure's first forecast on operational input -- GFS 2026-08-01 18Z, one 306x244x49 domain at 12 km over North America, through the shipped `gpuwm go` front door -- ran one forecast hour and then failed the full-state health gate with EVERY prognostic class violated (wind, specific volume, theta, moisture, moment): u = -522 m/s at k=38. Two things were measured in the clean hour before it. (1) A SPURIOUS SECOND TURBULENCE MAXIMUM aloft: the prognostic subgrid energy falls to its floor above the boundary layer as it should, and then REGROWS between 11.3 and 13.9 km to 1.62 m2/s2 -- 62 percent of its own boundary-layer peak of 2.60 -- centred on k=38, the level the gate then failed at. A boundary-layer closure has no business producing energy of that order at the tropopause, and with the km_opt=0 this scheme requires there is no other horizontal operator up there to damp it. (2) A DEEPER BOUNDARY LAYER THAN THE CONTROL THROUGHOUT: PBLH median 1967 m against 1558 m, p90 3962 against 2793, maximum 8900 against 4847, and 9.5 percent of columns above 4 km against 1.2 percent. Read the co-location of the aloft maximum and the failure level as a lead, not as a proven cause: this is ONE case, ONE cycle and ONE hour, and the same configuration also failed the gate under the stock YSU control -- later, at 3 h, and on the wind class alone. What separates them is not measured, and cannot be with the configuration schema as it stands: km_opt=0 is admitted only with this scheme, so the control that would hold the mixing configuration fixed and vary only the closure cannot be expressed.

The MYNN surface layer is admitted under SASE on the field contract alone: it publishes the friction velocity, the heat and moisture fluxes and the gust-corrected wind speed the closure reads, and nothing else in the closure is surface-layer specific. pbl/shinhong.label: Shin-Hong PBL
warnings: Shin-Hong's distance from WRF v4.6.1 is MEASURED on both halves of the port. tools/shinhong_wrf461_oracle drives the byte-frozen phys/module_bl_shinhong.F at gfortran -O0 over a 30-case x 6-grid-spacing x 40-level fixture built to reach branches, and the float32 CPU authority gpuwm/verify/shinhong_ref.py reproduces every output field of both arms bitwise -- max ULP 0 (tests/test_shinhong_wrf461_parity.py). The CUDA kernel's distance from the same pinned WRF words was measured 2026-08-03 on one RTX 5090 and is asserted for EQUALITY in the same test module: the heat tendency bitwise (0 ULP on every non-NaN lane through both tridiagonal solves), PBLH/WSTAR/DELTA 1 ULP, EXCH_H 8, EL 14, TKE 2022, and momentum/moisture tendencies up to 9.3e4/3.5e5 ULP -- near-total cancellations (the worst du lane is 3.4966e-06 against 3.4756e-06 m/s2) plus the flush lanes the last warning records. That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation: no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, and no gpuwm run has ever been checked against WRF with bl_pbl_physics=11. That is why this option is 'implemented-unverified' and not 'supported'.

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, WRF is undefined: with the TKE diagnostic on and the PBL filling the column (kpbl == kte), module_bl_shinhong.F:1557 reads q2xk(kpbl+1), one element past an array declared kts:kte. Both halves of the port compute the entrainment flux efxpbl only for kpbl < kte -- the defined behaviour -- behind the guards at gpuwm/verify/shinhong_ref.py:1275 and kernels/shinhong.cu:1429, and the oracle fixture never exercises the undefined arm: case 22, the kpbl == kte column, runs tke_diag=0 for exactly this reason.

WRF's OWN 0/0, reproduced rather than repaired: when ust is subnormal its cube underflows to exactly zero, and with hfx=+0.0, qfx=-0.0 the surface-flux term wstar3 is zero while sfcflg stays true, so module_bl_shinhong.F:1010 computes prfac2 = 15.9*wstar3/ust3/(1.+4.*karman*wstar3/ust3) = 0/0 and the NaN fills the heat column through the tridiagonal solve. The fixture pins one such column (case 13) and the authority and the kernel both reproduce the identical NaN geometry, pinned as lane counts. Those lanes are held out of the bitwise table by the NaN token alone: the oracle's ES24.16E3 format wrote sign-less NaN, so the receipt cannot say which payload WRF held and bit identity is unknowable there -- geometry, count and location are pinned instead.

sm_120/FTZ, MEASURED in both directions -- countermeasured where it picked a branch, recorded where it flushes words. WRF selects the stability regime with br .gt. 0.0 (module_bl_shinhong.F:702-715, transcribed at gpuwm/verify/shinhong_ref.py:706); sm_120 DAZes a positive SUBNORMAL br to zero in every FP32 compare, and the plain-float32 kernel measurably took the convective arm where WRF takes the stable one (case 7: wstar 0.2362 against WRF's 0.0). The kernel closes that with the sh_f2d double-compare countermeasure and tests/test_shinhong_wrf461_parity.py proves the branch stays WRF's, so no branch divergence is held out of the parity table. What remains is the tendency flush: CuPy appends -ftz=true unconditionally and sm_120 flushes regardless, so on the 72 lanes where the pinned WRF module wrote a subnormal qv/qc/qi tendency (e.g. 4.28e-39) the kernel writes exactly zero -- physically nil, pinned as lane counts so neither the flush nor the fixture's reach can quietly disappear. This is the same mechanism the YSU warnings record as an OPEN correctness bug; here it is closed at the branch and bounded at the words.

requires_components_reasons.surface_layer: the UW scheme takes its lower boundary from the friction velocity and the surface heat and moisture fluxes (UST/HFX/QFX), which the revised MM5, classic MM5 and MYNN surface layers publish; the Eta layer publishes them too but its own PBLH scan reads the TKE_MYJ column only the MYJ PBL advances, and the off option writes none of them

pbl/uw.label: UW moist-turbulence PBL
warnings: The UW PBL's distance from WRF v4.7.1 is MEASURED against the byte-unmodified CAMUWPBL sources: tools/uwpbl_wrf471_oracle builds them at gfortran -O0 and records every step of six regime families (convective day, stable night, stratocumulus, valley cold pool, mixed-phase, shallow cumulus) on three vertical grids, and the binary64 CPU reference gpuwm/verify/uwpbl_ref and the CUDA kernel are graded against those words bit for bit (tests/test_uwpbl_driver_wrf471_parity.py). That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation: no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison and no observation score exists for this scheme yet, which is why this option is 'implemented-unverified'.

THE ONE LICENCE-BOUND DIFFERENCE: WRF's cos and acos are glibc's binary64 IBM Accurate Mathematical Library (GNU Lesser General Public License), which is not transcribed; the kernel uses correctly rounded cos/acos instead (gpuwm/core/kernels/glibc_flt64.cuh). They enter only the trigonometric root of the entrainment cubic, and where glibc does not round correctly there a column can differ from WRF in its last bits; the rate is measured and stated in the kernel header. exp, log and pow are glibc's own (Arm optimized-routines, MIT) and bitwise.

WRF-AS-BUILT: gfortran's -O2 -ftree-vectorize build of these sources (WRF's configure default) is not byte-identical to its -O0 build on this toolchain: the vectoriser routes loops in eddy_diff through libmvec's cos/pow and folds x**2._r8 to x*x. The port follows the -O0 build, which calls glibc's scalar functions everywhere.

pbl/ysu.label: YSU PBL
warnings: YSU RUNS and its distance from WRF is now MEASURED rather than assumed. Until 2026-07-26 this option was maturity 'supported' with no warnings and no WRF number of any kind: the CUDA kernel had only ever been compared to gpuwm.verify.npref.np_ysu_column, a float64 mirror of the same transcription, so a misread line agreed with itself. tools/ysu_wrf461_oracle now drives bl_ysu_run in the byte-unmodified phys/physics_mmm/bl_ysu.F90 at the pinned commit and dumps 24 columns x 40 levels of inputs and outputs. Measured on two RTX 5090s with identical maxima (tests/test_ysu_wrf461_parity.py): potential-temperature tendency 1 ULP, EXCH_H/EXCH_M 7 ULP (2.4e-04 m2/s), PBLH/WSTAR/DELTA 1 ULP, KPBL exact, and the momentum and moisture tendencies 1457 and 23302 ULP -- which is 4.2e-08 m/s2 and 3.1e-11 kg/kg/s in absolute terms, because those tendencies are near-total cancellations that amplify a 7-ULP diffusivity. What remains is CUDA's expf/powf against glibc's; respelling ust**3, cbrtf and WRF's exact association for fric, xkzm, prnumfac and entfac was measured and changes none of it.

CORRECTNESS BUG, not a parity gap: a POSITIVE SUBNORMAL BR selects the WRONG STABILITY REGIME. WRF's test is br > 0.0 (bl_ysu.F90:613); the kernel's is br <= 0.0f, and CuPy appends -ftz=true unconditionally, so a br of 1.4e-45 flushes to zero and the kernel takes the CONVECTIVE arm where WRF takes the STABLE one. Measured on that column: WSTAR 0.236 against WRF's 0, DELTA 18.49 against WRF's 0, PBLH 1525 ULP out, and every tendency 1e7 to 1e8 ULP out. The smallest NORMAL br (1.17549435e-38) agrees exactly, which is how the cause is known to be the flush and not the operator. This is the FOURTH time -ftz has produced a real bug in this tree. Closing it needs a compare that cannot be flushed; --ftz=false is not available through CuPy.

gpuwm SHORT CIRCUITS a case WRF computes. kernels/ysu.cu:250 returns zero tendencies, PBLH = dz(1) and KPBL = 1 whenever UST, HFX and QFX are all zero (outside the urban flag_bep arm, which takes its surface flux from the BEP terms). bl_ysu_run has no such branch: measured on that column it produces a 703 m PBL with nine levels in it, EXCH_M of 0.143 m2/s and nonzero momentum tendencies. -ftz makes the same branch fire on a SUBNORMAL ust, i.e. on a nonzero input. Not fixed here because removing the branch exposes WRF's own 0/0 (next warning) and is not a one-line change.

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, WRF is undefined: with ust**3 underflowed to zero, wstar3 zero and sfcflg true, bl_ysu.F90:963 computes prfac2 = 15.9*(wstar3+wstar3_2)/ust3/(1.+4.*karman*(...)/ust3) = 0/0 and fills the column with NaN -- pinned in the oracle fixture. gpuwm returns finite numbers. Separately, at kpbl == kte with cloud at kpbl-1, bl_ysu.F90:846 reads thlix(i,k+2) one element past an array declared kts:kte; kernels/ysu.cu:437 guards that access with kpbl < nz and skips the top-down block instead.

WRF's default surface-drag arm is implemented: module_bl_ysu.F:404 passes ctopo and ctopo2 and bl_ysu.F90:1308 applies their drag. The selected kernel carries the paj, GET_PBLH and Beljaars vconv calculation; tests/test_ysu_wrf461_parity.py pins zero momentum ULP against that arm and retains the separate 182 ULP comparison to the historical ctopo-absent reference. This is column evidence, not qualification against a WRF forecast.

-ftz=true also FLUSHES SUBNORMAL TENDENCIES to exactly zero. Eleven lanes of the oracle fixture carry a subnormal qv/qc/qi tendency from WRF and the kernel writes zero in all eleven, which reads as up to 207470 ULP but is 3.3e-13 kg/kg/s. Physically nil; it is recorded because it is the same mechanism as the br bug above, where the consequence was not nil.

UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. The oracle compares one YSU call at a time on synthetic columns. No gpuwm/WRF trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, and no gpuwm run has ever been checked against WRF with bl_pbl_physics=1. That, plus the open items above, is why this is no longer 'supported'.

radiation/wrf-rrtm-dudhia.label: WRF RRTM longwave + Dudhia shortwave
warnings: WRF RRTM LONGWAVE IS IMPLEMENTED-UNVERIFIED. gpuwm/core/rrtm_lw.py, gpuwm/core/rrtm_taumol.py and gpuwm/core/rrtm_tables.py transcribe phys/module_ra_rrtm.F (O3DATA, MM5ATM, SETCOEF, CMBGB1-16, TAUGB1-16, GASABS, RTRN, RRTM/RRTMLWRAD) against the byte-frozen WRF v4.6.1 source, and the coefficient tables are the packaged RRTM_DATA records reduced 256 g-points to 140 by the module's own CMBGB weighting. WHAT WAS TESTED: column smoke through the shipped seams (tests/test_rrtm_longwave.py) on synthetic 40-level profiles -- finite FP32 output, GLW and OLR inside physical bounds, clear-column cooling at every layer, cloud-top cooling against cloud-base warming, OLR falling under cloud, GLW rising with a warmer surface, and RTRN's flux-divergence identity closing over the whole column including the Cavallo buffer -- plus initialize_physics resolving the 1/1 pair to RRTMDudhiaRadiation, namelist_import admitting ra_lw_physics=1 natively, and a mutation control that fails when the longwave contribution is stubbed out. Two checks are anchored outside the port rather than to itself: RRTM's band-summed Planck table reproduces the Stefan-Boltzmann blackbody sigma*T^4/pi to 5e-5 relative at 160/200/250/288/300/339 K and at three fractional temperatures, and a 345 K surface is clamped to MM5ATM's 339.99 K ceiling instead of running off the end of the table. Three mutation controls guard what the assertions are worth: zeroed band optical depths, zeroed TAUCLOUD, and a reintroduced one-row Planck index offset that must fail the blackbody identity while every physical-signature check stays green. WHAT WAS NOT TESTED: NO ORACLE COMPARISON AGAINST THE WRF FORTRAN EXISTS. No ULP measurement, no matched WRF run, no forecast trajectory comparison, no bit-for-bit claim. The oracle campaign is the declared next stage, as it was for Shin-Hong and Grell-Freitas.

The 1/1 pair is a COMPOSITION, not a coupled adapter: RRTMDudhiaRadiation runs gpuwm.core.rrtm_lw.RRTMLongwaveRadiation and gpuwm.core.dudhia.DudhiaShortwaveRadiation and merges their results, mirroring module_radiation_driver.F's independent lwrad_select/swrad_select dispatch. RRTM owns GLW (provenance 'scheme'), so the pair never depends on a carried-in GLW value.

Supported path only, fail-closed elsewhere: no WRF-Chem, ghg_input=0 (the analytic year-dependent CO2/N2O/CH4 of RRTMLWRAD F:1855-1861), O3DATA's own summer/winter ozone climatology, and no CFC/CCl4 cross sections (WRF's MM5ATM sets WX to zero, F:4005-4009). Longwave and shortwave selections compose independently.

PERFORMANCE AND TRANSIENT MEMORY: classic RRTM evaluates CuPy column blocks. The experiment column_chunk setting now caps those blocks as well as modern radiation; reducing it lowers solver workspace and may increase dispatch time without changing the per-column answer. Preflight prices the actual window, pressure-dependent buffer layers, coefficient tables and capped solver live sets. Bare legacy configurations with an unresolved pressure top retain an explicitly unpriced classic workspace until initialization supplies it.

surface_layer/eta-similarity.label: Eta similarity surface layer
warnings: The Eta similarity surface layer is implemented-unverified because no matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory exists for it, but its CUDA kernel (gpuwm/core/kernels/myjsfc.cu) and its host similarity tables are BIT-IDENTICAL to WRF v4.6.1's own MYJSFC and MYJSFCINIT. tools/myjsfc_wrf461_oracle compiles the byte-unmodified phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F at gfortran 13.3 -O0 (WRF's own -O2 -ftree-vectorize -funroll-loops build writes the same bytes; neither has an FMA or a libmvec call) and drives 224 columns -- convective and stable land, snow and sea ice, warm, cold and storm-force ocean, terrain to 4.4 km, calm air, cloud water, a TKE column that never drops below EPSQ2 and a dead one, a boundary layer above 1000 m, extreme instability and stability, a saturated cold column, a lowest layer under 4 m and the two-level minimum column -- through MYJSFCINIT and three consecutive MYJSFC calls (cold start at ITIMESTEP 1 and warm seeded state across the three sea viscous regimes); the fixture executes every line of MYJSFC and SFCDIF. Every word of all 35 INOUT and output fields is identical, replayed and free-running, under the strict build (GPUWM_WRF_EXACT=1) and under default arithmetic, and all 4 x 10,001 PSIM/PSIH table words match (tests/test_myjsfc_wrf461_parity.py). A further 8,192 columns with randomly drawn regimes, four calls each (32,768 column-calls, tools/myjsfc_wrf461_oracle/stress.sh), are identical too, and so is the float32 CPU authority (gpuwm/verify/myj_ref.py np_myjsfc_column, graded on CPU). The kernel seeds ZINT(KTE+1)=HT as WRF does (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:165), calls ArWen's own float32 gfk_log/gfk_exp_fma/gfk_pow (graded against the oracle host's C library over all 2**32 inputs by tools/myjsfc_wrf461_oracle/libm_sweep.py: one input differs, 1 ULP of POW at x = 0.00825 with exponent 1/CAPA, which needs a surface pressure below 0.01 Pa) and compiles without FMA contraction; the host tables use ArWen's own float32 logf/atanf/expf. That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation.

MYJ and the Eta similarity surface layer are selected TOGETHER or not at all. WRF v4.6.1's own law is one-directional -- phys/module_physics_init.F:3770-3772 fatals bl_pbl_physics=2 unless the surface layer set isfc=2, which only sf_sfclay_physics=2 does among the layers gpuwm ports (:3169) -- and ArWen adds the reverse refusal for a stated reason: the Eta layer publishes AKHS/AKMS/THZ0/QZ0/UZ0/VZ0 and publishes NO MOL, ZOL, PSIM/PSIH, REGIME, GZ1OZ0 or WSPD (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:361-1056), while YSU, MYNN, Shin-Hong and SASE each read at least one of those. Pairing them would hand a PBL scheme a zero where WRF hands it a similarity function: finite, plausible and wrong. gpuwm.config.validate_myj_pairing is that refusal.

WRF quirks transcribed rather than repaired, each cited in the port. CT (the countergradient correction) is identically zero in ARW: MYJSFC zeroes it every call (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:206-211) and SFCDIF's countergradient block is commented out (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:816-825, CT=0.), so MIXLEN's DTH+CT fix (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:845-850) and VDIFH's RKCT term add exactly zero -- both seams are still built so a future WRF that restores them lands in the right place. CZIL is hard-coded to 0.1 because the Chen-Zhang block is commented out (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:689-697), which is why IVGTYP/ISURBAN/IZ0TLND are dead arguments and why gpuwm.config refuses isftcflx/iz0tlnd with this surface layer. The Zilitinkevich thermal-roughness fix reads Z0BASE, not the working ZNT (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:733). DIFCOF's inversion block is commented out (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:1275-1322), so its T argument is dead and the port does not take it.

OUT OF SCOPE, refused rather than approximated. WRF sends the MYJ PBL through myjurb (phys/module_bl_myjurb.F:130-771) when sf_urban_physics is 2 or 3, the BEP/BEM multi-layer urban canopies (phys/module_physics_init.F:3775-3781). gpuwm does the same: PhysicsDriver._run_myj_pbl routes MYJ to gpuwm.core.myjurb under the bep and bep-bem urban options. With sf_surface_physics=0 the land branch stops evolving surface humidity rather than failing: MYJPBL rebuilds QSFC over land from ELFLX and CHKLOWQ, both of which an LSM writes, and its IF(QFC1>0.) guard leaves QSFC untouched when they are zero (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:547-557). That is WRF's own behaviour and it is admitted, not refused -- but a land run without an LSM is a land run whose surface moisture is frozen at its initial value. The MYJPBL species stack is WRF's own three or four rows (theta, vapour, cloud water and cloud ice when the moist set carries it): the QCS/QCR/QCG rows the source declares are commented out upstream (:274-285) and are not ported. The kernel holds the column in per-thread local memory like YSU's, so it carries the same 128-level ceiling and refuses a deeper column rather than truncating it.
